mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.user_id, c.name, c.note, c.status, c.ended_at, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at, COUNT(cr.record_id) AS member_count, MIN(r.created_at) AS coverage_start_at, MAX(r.created_at) AS coverage_end_at FROM time_chapter c LEFT JOIN time_chapter_record cr ON cr.chapter_id = c.id AND cr.user_id = c.user_id LEFT JOIN `record` r ON r.id = cr.record_id AND r.user_id = c.user_id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, name, note, status, ended_at, version, created_at, updated_at FROM time_chapter WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
GROUP BY c.id, c.user_id, c.name, c.note, c.status, c.ended_at, c.version, c.created_at, c.updated_at ORDER BY c.id ASC
